n6187035318.name: Stroud Showground Camping
n6187035318.description: Council showground camping in Stroud with 15 powered sites, amenities and showers. Maximum stay 7 days; a confirmed online booking is required before occupying a site and fees are paid at booking. Camping closes at times for local events.

n11404239093.name: Bulahdelah Showground
n11404239093.description: RV-only overnight stays at Bulahdelah Showground. RVs must have self-contained grey and black water tanks; tents and swags are not permitted. No pre-bookings, first in first choice. Accessible amenities, showers, town water, bins and a dump point at the Myall Street entrance. Fee not stated on the council page.

n1811193685.name: Rocks Crossing Campground
n1811193685.description: Large open grassy council campground beside the Nowendoc River with a wood-fire BBQ and picnic facilities. No power; basic toilets only. No bookings; maximum stay 14 nights. Fee not stated on the council page.
n1811193685.source_note: Council map pin is -31.6775, 152.0093 (Nowendoc Road, Number One); OSM point is about 12 km SE. Location needs a check.

w57838748.name: Gloryvale Reserve Campgrounds
w57838748.description: Free council campsite on the Manning River with shallow swimming holes, wood BBQ pits and a basic toilet; gravel and river-pebble surface with shade. No bookings; maximum stay 14 nights. Campgrounds closed after the May 2025 floods.

closed_override.wording: The Gloryvale campgrounds are closed until further noticed due to the impact of the floods on the area.

w674855005.description: Coachwood camping area in Chichester State Forest (Telegherry River side), on the opposite bank to Frying Pan Creek; popular with family groups. Telegherry may be closed and gated after wet weather.

w674855006.description: Frying Pan Creek: popular camping and picnic area on the Telegherry River in Chichester State Forest; start of the 2 km return Problem Creek Falls walk. Telegherry may be closed and gated after wet weather.

w674855008.access_notes: 4WD only (river crossing varies in depth after rain)
w674855008.description: Currawong: quiet camping spot on the Telegherry River in Chichester State Forest. 4WD access only because of a river crossing that quickly varies in depth after rainfall.

w674855010.description: Telegherry Forest Rest Area in Chichester State Forest, with separate picnic and camping areas beside the river and short walks. May be closed and gated after wet weather.

w675579702.description: Coopernook Forest Headquarters, north of Coopernook: picnic and overnight stay area in eucalypt forest with free electric BBQs. Caravans and campervans welcome; unpowered, no dump station.

w405985967.description: Manning River camping and picnic area in Barrington Tops State Forest, next to Henry's Bridge on Pheasants Creek Road; popular with 4WD visitors and freshwater fishers. Take all rubbish with you.

new:barrington-reserve-midcoast.name: Barrington Reserve
new:barrington-reserve-midcoast.description: Council camping reserve on the Barrington River with 7 sites (up to 12 people each), shade and river access by steps. No power; basic toilets only. Not a free campground: per-site fees paid at booking. Maximum stay 14 nights.

n1811172916.name: Ellenborough Reserve
n1811172916.description: Large free council camping reserve on the Ellenborough River with picnic tables, BBQs and toilets. No bookings; follow the signage on entry for rules. Maximum stay is not stated on the council page.

w614188701.name: Swans Crossing
w614188701.description: Swans Crossing camping and picnic area in Kerewong State Forest, about 20 minutes' drive from Kew, on former farmland by Upsalls Creek. Caravans and campervans welcome. Nature playground and short walks (Cascade, The Gorge) start here.

w462465967.description: Wild Bull Camping Area (Cobrabald) in Mount Boss State Forest, a short drive from Wauchope: off-the-beaten-track camping with BBQ facilities and a deep waterhole. Entry via Cobrabald Road from Five Ways junction.

n10152659374.name: Stockyard Creek Rest Area
n10152659374.description: Transport for NSW light-vehicle rest area on the Oxley Highway, 80.4 km west of Wauchope, with toilets (incl. accessible), BBQ, picnic tables and bins. TfNSW does not state an overnight rule.

w1290379246.name: Kempsey Showground Camping
w1290379246.max_nights: 21 (14 in peak periods; 4 for tents; 50 days per year)
w1290379246.description: Primitive camping ground at Kempsey Showground, West Kempsey, with powered sites, water, amenities and dump point access (grey water must be collected). $30 per site per night for up to two people, $5 each extra person. Bookings required in advance. Check-in from 11am until the gates close (5.30pm winter, 6pm daylight saving).

w1430442089.name: Gumma Reserve
w1430442089.description: Council-owned primitive camping reserve at 94 Boultons Crossing Road, Gumma. No bookings: pay by QR code on entry (EFTPOS only). Off-season $24 single / $30 double; peak $30 single / $35 double; family $35. Flushing toilets, outdoor showers, RV dump point and unfiltered tank water. No buses. Caretaker 0429 366 456 (8am to 12pm).

n1811197302.name: Taylors Arm Sports Reserve
n1811197302.description: Taylors Arm Sports Reserve, 45 Taylors Arm Road. Council lists it among the fee-paying alternatives to free camping in Macksville; its facility page lists BBQ, picnic area, playground and toilets. Camping fees and rules are not stated; enquiries to the reserve.

w380919070.description: Private caravan park at 25 Riverside Drive, Nambucca Heads. Listed by Nambucca Valley Council as a fee-paying alternative caravan park; not council-operated.
w380919070.source_note: Our category 'council_park' looks wrong; the park is privately owned (listed for sale in 2026).

new:macksville-ferry-street-lions-park.name: Ferry Street Lions Park, Macksville (overnight stays)
new:macksville-ferry-street-lions-park.description: Council-permitted free overnight stop for travellers in vehicles: 8 vehicle spaces. No parking in long-vehicle bays; no tents, camper trailers or annexes. Maximum one night; signposted time frames apply and rangers patrol. Nearest dump point: Macksville Memorial Aquatic & Fitness Centre, 23 Cooper Street.
new:macksville-ferry-street-lions-park.source_note: Coordinates and toilets from the TfNSW rest-area record 'Macksville Lions Park' (Cooper Street); council calls it Ferry Street Lions Park. Check the pin.

new:macksville-aquatic-centre-rv.name: Macksville Memorial Aquatic & Fitness Centre (RV overnight bays)
new:macksville-aquatic-centre-rv.description: 4 designated overnight spaces for self-contained caravans and RVs only; no tents. Maximum one night; signposted time frames apply and rangers patrol. The area's only dump point is here (23 Cooper Street).
new:macksville-aquatic-centre-rv.source_note: Coordinates are the aquatic centre's OSM footprint, not a council pin.

n1811193861.name: Roses Park Rest Area (Roses Road Reserve), Thora
n1811193861.description: Bellingen Shire Council permitted overnight camping area at Roses Road Reserve, Waterfall Way, Thora (14.2 km west of Bellingen). Council-managed rest area with toilets and BBQ. Max stay is not on the council page (signposted on site).
n1811193861.source_note: fee_type free: neither source mentions a fee; council lists it as a permitted overnight area. Toilets and BBQ come from TfNSW.

n1811163574.name: Burdett Park, Fernmount
n1811163574.description: Bellingen Shire Council permitted overnight camping area at Burdett Park, Waterfall Way, Fernmount (council rest area with toilets). Max stay and fees are not on the council page.

w219622683.exclude_reason: Duplicate: park polygon (leisure=park) for the same site as Bellingen Showgrounds (n1811161456).

n6326563445.name: Eastern Dorrigo Community Hall and Showground (Ulong)
n6326563445.operator: Eastern Dorrigo Community Hall Committee (City of Coffs Harbour facility)
n6326563445.description: Bush camping area at the Eastern Dorrigo Community Hall and Showground, 13 Pine Avenue, Ulong (35 km from Coffs Harbour), for a small nominal fee per person. Flat, grassy and shaded, with picnic table, public toilets, water, and showers (arrange access at the Ulong General Store). Enquiries via the Ulong General Store.

w1432186168.name: Corindi Beach Reserve
w1432186168.description: Primitive camping at Corindi Beach Reserve, 36 km north of Coffs Harbour and a 500 m walk to the beach. 30 unpowered sites with toilets and hot showers. $25 per night for up to 2 adults, $10 each extra adult, children free. Caravans, big rigs and tents welcome. Online booking advised; latest check-in 7pm. Quiet hours 10pm to 7am, no generators.
w1432186168.source_note: Crown-gazetted reserve; the source is the reserve operator's own site, not council.

n5544902021.name: Maclean Showground Campground
n5544902021.description: Primitive campground at Maclean Showground, 12 Cameron Street, Maclean. Up to 10 campsites, maximum 3-night stay, first in first served with no bookings. Toilets and dump point, no showers. Pets on leash. No tents.
n5544902021.source_note: My Clarence Valley is an initiative of Clarence Valley Council. Fee amount not verified (council fees PDF would not download).

n3970935776.name: Copmanhurst Sport and Recreation Reserve
n3970935776.description: Primitive camping at the Copmanhurst Recreation Reserve on Clarence Way, Copmanhurst, for caravans, motorhomes and big rigs. Toilets and showers; boat ramp nearby. Registered dogs on leash.
n3970935776.source_note: Listed as site 53 in the council's Happy Camping guide. OSM notes the main ablutions were fenced off (no shower) as of 2026-03; on-site check advised.

n1811177122.name: Glenreagh Camping Reserve
n1811177122.booking: unpowered: no booking needed; powered: must be booked
n1811177122.description: Camping and recreation reserve at 14 Bridge Street, Glenreagh, a short walk from the main street. Powered and unpowered sites, camp kitchen, communal shower and beer garden; suits caravans, big rigs and tents. Pet friendly (enquire). No booking needed for unpowered sites; powered sites must be booked.

n1811171999.name: Diggers Camp
n1811171999.season: December, January and NSW/Queensland school holidays
n1811171999.description: Primitive, off-grid tent park above Diggers Camp Beach, 540 Miners Street, 4 km of unsealed road north of Wooli. 26 unpowered sites and a long-drop toilet; bring all supplies and water. Open December, January and NSW and Queensland school holidays.
n1811171999.source_note: Listed as site 46 'Diggers Headland Reserve Camping Ground' in the council guide. Separate from NPWS Boorkoom campground about 600 m away.

new:ulmarra-small-park-showground.description: Ulmarra Showground (officially Small Park), Coldstream Street, Ulmarra. Eight unpowered sites for RVs and fully self-contained travellers, small nightly fee paid at the honesty box, no booking (first in basis), maximum 3 consecutive days. Toilets, showers and town water; pet friendly. Nearest dump point is Maclean Showground.

w917420080.description: Richmond Valley Council has 12 free unpowered sites at Casino Showground and Racecourse for owners of fully self-contained vehicles. Book by phone (02 6660 0325) between 8.30am and 4.30pm. Toilets and showers are available during events. Dogs are generally not permitted because of the active race track.

n1811188806.description: Campground at Mullumbimby Showground, 62 Main Arm Road, Mullumbimby. Powered $40 and unpowered $35 per night for up to two people (kids under 14 free); single campers $35 powered or $30 unpowered. Book ahead with the caretakers. Check-in 11am to 5pm, check-out 10am. No fires; quiet 10pm to 6am. Pets welcome in designated areas.
